title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description**
Beyond Expectations is a dynamic events and digital marketing company that specializes in creating bold, high-impact brand experiences. The team brings concepts to life through curated events such as launches, pop-ups and concerts, as well as through innovative digital storytelling. BE’s services span social media, content creation, branding, influencer collaborations, and performance-driven campaigns. The company values creativity, strong visual identity, and memorable narratives, aiming to turn every project into an engaging, trend-forward experience. Applicants can expect a fast-paced, collaborative environment that celebrates fresh ideas and strong design thinking.

**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Graphic Designer role is based in Thrissur, Kerala. The Graphic Designer will create visual assets for events and digital campaigns, including graphics for social media, websites, presentations, and promotional materials. Typical responsibilities include developing brand-aligned concepts, designing logos, refining typography and layouts, and preparing files for both digital and print use. The role involves collaborating closely with marketing and content to ensure cohesive visual storytelling across all touchpoints. The Graphic Designer will also support ongoing brand evolution by maintaining design guidelines, exploring new visual trends, and contributing to creative ideation sessions.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Graphics and Graphic Design.
* Ability to create and refine Logo Design and Branding elements that align with campaign.
* Proficiency in Typography, layout design, and visual composition.
* Advanced experience with industry-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Figma or similar).
* Portfolio demonstrating creative, contemporary design work across social media, marketing materials, and event-related assets.
* Ability to work on-site in Thrissur, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with openness to feedback and iterative design processes.
* Relevant education or equivalent experience in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.

title: Web Designer
description:
**Company Description**
Flyon Technologies LLP is a growing technology company focused on delivering modern, user-centric digital solutions for a variety of clients. The team works on web and design projects that prioritize usability, performance, and visual appeal. As a collaborative organization, Flyon Technologies LLP values creativity, problem-solving, and continuous learning. The company offers opportunities to work with diverse projects and tools, encouraging team members to expand their technical and design skills.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Web Designer role based in Thodupuzha. The Web Designer will create and maintain visually appealing, user-friendly websites that align with client requirements and brand guidelines. Daily responsibilities include designing web layouts and graphics, developing responsive interfaces, collaborating with developers and content creators, and refining designs based on feedback and usability considerations. The role also involves optimizing designs for different devices and browsers, preparing design assets, and staying current with web design trends and best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Web Design and Responsive Web Design.
* Candidates should possess skills in Graphic Design and creating high-quality Graphics.
* Candidates should possess practical Front-End Development skills for implementing design concepts.
* Candidates should possess a good understanding of usability, accessibility, and modern UI/UX principles.
* Candidates should possess proficiency with design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator).
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess strong attention to detail, time management abilities, and a portfolio demonstrating relevant web design work.
* A diploma or degree in Design, Computer Science, or a related field is beneficial; equivalent practical experience is also valued.

title: Interior Designer
description: Company Description INNODA (Innovative Design & Architecture) is a design-focused practice that integrates architecture and interior design to create functional, aesthetically refined spaces. The firm emphasizes innovation, thoughtful space utilization, and alignment with client needs and project context. INNODA works across a range of residential and commercial projects, delivering tailored solutions from concept through execution. The team values collaboration, precision, and design excellence, offering professionals a setting to contribute ideas and grow their skills. Joining INNODA means being part of a studio that balances creativity with technical rigor in every project.Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Interior Designer role based in Thrissur. The Interior Designer will develop design concepts, prepare space plans, and select materials, finishes, and FF&E (furniture, fixtures, and equipment) aligned with project requirements and budgets. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with architects and consultants, producing detailed drawings and presentations, coordinating with vendors and contractors, and ensuring design intent is maintained during execution. title: Graphic Designer
description:
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our team and support the branding, marketing, digital communication, and business development activities of BIMEX Engineers and its products.

The candidate will be responsible for creating high-quality visual content for websites, social media, presentations, advertisements, marketing campaigns, company profiles, proposals, and other digital and print materials while maintaining consistency with our brand guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Graphic Design & Branding**

* Design creative and professional graphics for company and product branding.
* Develop social media creatives, banners, posters, brochures, flyers, and promotional materials.
* Maintain consistency in brand colours, typography, layouts, and visual identity.

**2. Digital Marketing Design**

* Create visual content for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Google Ads, and other digital platforms.
* Design campaign creatives based on marketing objectives and target audiences.
* Create website banners, landing-page graphics, icons, illustrations, and other web assets.
* Work closely with the marketing team to develop creatives for lead-generation campaigns.

**3. Business & Sales Support**

* Design company presentations, capability statements, proposals, brochures, and pitch decks.
* Create project case studies and project showcase materials.
* Prepare graphics and visual content required for client presentations and business development activities.
* Support sales and marketing teams with customized client-facing materials.

**4. Video & Motion Graphics**

* Create basic promotional videos, reels, animated posts, and motion graphics.
* Edit short-form marketing videos for social media and digital campaigns.
* Add text, transitions, graphics, subtitles, and branding elements to videos.

**5. Collaboration**

* Work closely with Marketing, Business Development, HR, BIM, and Management teams.
* Understand briefs and convert ideas into visually compelling designs.
* Take feedback and make revisions within agreed timelines.
* Maintain organized design files and reusable templates.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
* Good knowledge of Adobe InDesign or equivalent design tools.
* Experience with Figma and/or Canva is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of video editing and motion graphics.
* Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, and visual hierarchy.
* Good understanding of social media design requirements and digital advertising formats.
* Ability to maintain brand consistency across different media.
* Strong attention to detail and visual quality.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Adobe Photoshop/ CorelDRAW
* Adobe InDesign, Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
* Figma.
* Canva Pro.
* UI/UX design fundamentals.
* Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS is an advantage.
* Experience designing for B2B / Engineering / Construction / Technology companies is preferred.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Fine Arts, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in graphic design or digital marketing design.
* Candidates with a strong portfolio may be considered regardless of academic specialization.

title: Interior Designer
description:
Interior Designer – Residential / Commercial

**Byts Interior Pvt. Ltd.**

**Location:**
Kallekkad, Palakkad, Kerala

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About BYTS

BYTS Interior is a factory-direct interior design and modular manufacturer in Palakkad, serving homeowners, Gulf NRIs, builders, and developers across Kerala and Tamil Nadu. With our own CNC manufacturing facility and Coohom-driven design-to-production workflow, we take every project from design to factory-precision delivery.
*We produce what you design — with factory precision.*

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Interior Designer to lead residential interior projects from concept to handover. The ideal candidate is a creative problem solver with strong client management skills and a proven record of delivering high-quality full-home interiors. You will shape the BYTS customer experience, set the standard for design quality, and bridge the gap between client vision and factory production.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end residential interior projects, from first client meeting to final handover.
* Understand each client’s lifestyle, preferences, budget, and functional needs, including NRI clients engaged remotely.
* Develop space plans, layouts, mood boards, 3D concepts, and design presentations.
* Create 3D designs and photorealistic renders in Coohom for client presentations and approvals.
* Prepare detailed technical and working drawings, and ensure designs are production-ready for our factory.
* Prepare BoQs, material and hardware specifications, and cost estimates.
* Coordinate with the Technical Design team, factory, Site Supervisors, and installation teams to deliver on time.
* Coordinate with clients’ civil, electrical, plumbing, and lighting contractors to ensure interiors integrate correctly on site.
* Maintain design quality while keeping projects within timeline and budget.
* Support sales closures by presenting compelling design solutions and building client trust.
* Mentor and review the work of junior designers and interior architects.
* Stay current with design trends, materials, finishes, and modular hardware.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in residential interior design.
* Delivered 5+ full-home or turnkey residential projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, V-Ray/Lumion, and MS Office (including PowerPoint).
* Strong knowledge of modular furniture, materials, and hardware, with working knowledge of civil, electrical, lighting, and plumbing interfaces.
* Experience in BoQ preparation, project coordination, and vendor management.
* Fluent in Malayalam and English.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with Coohom or other cloud-based 3D design and rendering platforms.
* Strong design aesthetics and space-planning ability.
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, and client relationship skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Leadership and mentoring experience.
* Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Customer-first mindset with a passion for outstanding design experiences.

What We Offer

* Your designs go straight into our own factory, with full control over quality and finish.
* End-to-end ownership of projects and a leadership role in a growing design team.
* Competitive salary based on experience.

How to Apply

If you’re passionate about creating exceptional living spaces and ready for your next career step, we’d love to hear from you.

📩 Send your resume and portfolio to
**jobs@bytsinterior.com**

**Subject line: Application – Senior Interior Designer**

* **🌐 careers.byts.in | byts.in**

title: Interior Designer
description:
**Company Description**
ELEGANT ART INTERIORS is a design-focused firm specializing in creating functional and aesthetically pleasing interior spaces. Based in Thrissur, the company delivers tailored solutions for residential and commercial projects, emphasizing client collaboration and attention to detail. The team combines creativity with practical design principles to optimize space, comfort, and style. ELEGANT ART INTERIORS values innovation, quality workmanship, and a professional approach throughout every stage of a project.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time Interior Designer role is a hybrid position based in Thrissur, with the flexibility for some work-from-home tasks. The Interior Designer will develop design concepts, prepare layouts, and create mood boards and presentations that align with client requirements and project budgets. Day-to-day responsibilities include space planning, coordinating with architects and contractors, preparing and reviewing construction drawings, and selecting FF&E (furniture, fixtures, and equipment). The role involves site visits for measurements, quality checks, and progress reviews, as well as regular communication with clients and vendors to ensure timely project delivery. The Interior Designer will collaborate with the design team to refine details, maintain project documentation, and uphold brand standards.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Interior Design and Space Planning to create functional and visually appealing layouts.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Architecture and the ability to interpret and coordinate with architectural plans.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in preparing and reviewing Construction Drawings for accurate execution on site.
* Candidates should possess experience with FF&E selection, including materials, finishes, furniture, lighting, and accessories.
* Proficiency in design and drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, or similar) and presentation tools.
* Strong visual design sense, attention to detail, and understanding of current interior design trends.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Relevant diploma or degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a closely related field; prior experience in residential or commercial interiors is an advantage.

title: Enterprise User Experience Leader
description:
**About RedBlack** 




 RedBlack is a leading fintech product company specializing in investment management software. Our platform supports portfolio monitoring, rebalancing, tax optimization, trading, order management, and compliance for wealth management firms. RedBlack supports more than $1 trillion in client assets and is known for accuracy, reliability, and innovation in a highly specialized domain.
 



 We build products for complex, high\-value workflows. For us, UX is not cosmetic. It directly affects advisor productivity, operational confidence, decision quality, and customer trust.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As the
 **Enterprise User Experience Leader (UX Lead)** 
 , you will shape how users understand, navigate, and complete sophisticated investment management workflows. You will work across discovery, problem framing, interaction design, prototyping, validation, specification, and delivery support.
 



 This role is suited for a UX professional who can balance user needs, business rules, data complexity, technical constraints, and delivery realities. You will partner closely with Product, Business Analysis, Engineering, QA, and Delivery to create experiences that are intuitive, consistent, scalable, and enterprise\-grade.
 



 You will not simply produce screens. You will clarify workflows, reduce cognitive load, define reusable interaction patterns, improve design quality, and help teams make better product decisions earlier.
 



  





**Who You Are** 



* You are a product\-minded UX designer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems.
* You bring structure to ambiguity and can move from problem discovery to practical design direction.
* You care deeply about usability, clarity, consistency, accessibility, and enterprise\-grade detail.
* You are comfortable designing for business users, power users, operational teams, and data\-rich environments.
* You communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You can defend design decisions with evidence, reasoning, user empathy, and business context.
* You collaborate well, accept feedback constructively, and help raise the quality of the team.
* You balance ideal user experience with technical feasibility, timelines, and product priorities.



  





**What you will do** 



* Lead UX discovery for complex product areas by understanding users, workflows, business rules, pain points, and operational context
* Translate complex investment\-management workflows into clear information architecture, task flows, interaction models, and screen designs
* Create wireframes, prototypes, journey maps, user flows, design specifications, and handoff documentation
* Define intuitive experiences for data\-heavy screens, exception handling, multi\-step workflows, dashboards, forms, tables, and decision\-support interfaces
* Partner with Product Owners and Business Analysts to shape requirements, identify UX risks, and improve problem definition before development begins
* Work closely with engineers to ensure design intent is feasible, implemented accurately, and consistent with front\-end standards
* Use design systems, reusable patterns, and component guidance to improve consistency and delivery efficiency
* Apply accessibility, responsive behavior, usability heuristics, and enterprise design best practices to daily design decisions
* Facilitate design reviews, gather feedback, explain design rationale, and align stakeholders around user\-centered solutions
* Support validation through usability review, stakeholder walkthroughs, product demos, user feedback, and iterative refinement
* Mentor designers and help cross\-functional teams build stronger UX judgment and product thinking


- 


**Qualifications** 



* Strong skills in user experience design, including user journey mapping, information architecture, wireframing, and prototyping.
* Experience with user research methods such as interviews, surveys, usability testing, and analysis of behavioral data.
* Proficiency with modern design and collaboration tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar), and familiarity with design systems.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and business teams, and to present UX concepts and decisions clearly.
* Demonstrated experience leading UX initiatives or teams, with a portfolio showcasing complex, data\-rich applications or fintech products.
* Understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and best practices for web\-based enterprise software.
* Excellent problem\-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills, with attention to detail and a user\-centered mindset.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



  





**What Is a Plus** 



* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or investment technology.
* Experience modernizing legacy enterprise interfaces.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and modern front\-end frameworks.
* Experience collaborating in a fast\-paced, iterative product environment.



  





**Why Join RedBlack** 



* Shape UX for a sophisticated fintech platform used in high\-value investment management workflows.
* Work on meaningful enterprise product problems where design quality has direct business impact.
* Collaborate with teams that value thoughtful execution, ownership, and product excellence.
* Influence design standards, workflow clarity, and user experience maturity across the platform.
* Benefit from hybrid work, flexible hours, competitive compensation, and a high\-quality office environment.



  





**Contact Recruitment Team:** 
 recruitment\-india@redblacksoftware.com
